newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Green Property 1996 pretax profit up 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Green Property 1996 pretax profit up 34 pct.

text.p: Irish property group Green Property Plc on Thursday reported a rise of 34 percent in pre-tax profits to 8.5 million Irish pounds for the year to December 31, 1996.
"Recent signs of a sustained improvement in the UK markets are now evident and Green is well placed to participate in any uplift," Green property said in a results statement.
In Ireland it said the successful opening of the first phase of a development in Blanchardstown represents a "true milestone for the company".
It said its long term re-financing has made it (Blanchardstown) a platform from which the group can "now entertain wider ambitions".
